levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن الوليد القمي

notes: «وبالإسناد الأول» takes the head of prev6, the nearest report that writes its chain (prev1 to prev5 open with a back reference): its names before علي بن مهزيار are inherited, in order
The editor's bracket «[عن علي بن حديد]» is left out (rule 1); the chain reads as the text writes it outside the brackets
«أحدهما» is the text's own unnamed Imam (one of two): not completed; prev6's Imam Abu Ja'far is not written for it
